newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Telekom to launch third satellite late 1998.
newsitem.headline: Turk Telekom to launch third satellite late 1998.

text.p: Turkey's telecommunications company, Turk Telekom, will launch its third satellite towards the end of next year, its deputy general manager Cengiz Anik said on Wednesday.
"This is a $20-million investment. Turksat-2A will have 32 transponders," he told Anatolian news agency.
Turk Telekom has launched two satellites, Turksat-1 and Turksat-1C, in partnership with France.
"The third one will be launched towards the end of 1998, Anik said.
He said the satellite would pave the way for visual telephones and the viewing of 50 TV channels through a single antenna.
He did not give other information.
